write_up: You make a convincing case for accounts payable and staff accounting work. The current role gives a recruiter a useful measure: around 400 vendor invoices every month in QuickBooks. The one hesitation is what your month-end help involved.

The strongest line is the reduction in month-end closing from 12 days to 7 days. It names the change and the checklist and template behind it. Use that level of detail to show what your junior accounting team worked on, too.
